pivHint: Jesus says, "I am the BREAD of life." In slang, BREAD also means money, and so does another word for what a baker kneads: ______.
winText: You found it. BREAD isn't just what Jesus calls himself, the bread of life. In slang, BREAD and DOUGH both mean money.
lossText: The word was DOUGH. BREAD was the pivot. In slang, both BREAD and DOUGH mean money, and DOUGH is also the mixture a baker kneads and bakes into BREAD.
votdVerse: Then Jesus declared, I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
passageText: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.” “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.” Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty. But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.
